fields.label: Subject DocType
fields.description: Identifies the doctype of the record the signal is delivered to.

fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: Identifies the record the signal is delivered to.

fields.label: Event Name
fields.description: Names the event being delivered; a Wait waiting on this name consumes the row.

fields.label: Correlation
fields.description: Carries the token that ties this delivery to a specific wait, so a duplicate and a stale delivery are distinguishable and cannot wake the wrong loop iteration.

fields.label: Payload (JSON)
fields.description: Carries the external payload; the receiving Wait merges only its declared accepts paths into Instance state.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Records whether the signal is still Pending or has been Consumed by a Wait.

fields.label: Consumed By
fields.description: Records the Instance that consumed this signal, for audit.
